recent.text: Rockets lead 35-20 after one. Dominant quarter from Houston on both ends of the floor. KD and Sengun combined for 20 points. Warriors shot 6-20 from the field, 3-14 on 3s. Still no word on Steph Curry, who went to the locker room halfway thru the 1st quarter.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Unbelievable play by Tari Eason — forced Gui Santos near halfcourt and tipped his pass. Ball went down the other way and both Eason and Santos fought for it. With Santos grabbing his jersey, Eason bounced it off the GSW forward and out of bounds.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun have combined to score 20 of the Rockets' 28 points so far in the 1st. Houston's star duo picking up where they left off a few nights ago. Doing a really good job of working off each other in halfcourt sets.
